carry_report.notes: The carried files are UI/config metadata and language resources; they do not implement server team behavior.

implemented: Authenticated mod command context exposes the command player's stable UUID and name only during dispatch; console commands expose None.
Parties persist owner/member identity, invitations and team names through mod-scoped storage; each player's current team is stored under a UUID-derived key.
Creation, listing, member listing, UUID-target invitations, invitation acceptance, leave and owner succession/disband are implemented.
known_inaccuracies: The `msg` command calls `chat::show`; it is explicitly local-only and cannot deliver party chat to teammates.
Invite targets must be entered as UUID strings because there is no online-player lookup/completion API.
Storage keys team data in one mod-scoped data folder; there is no cross-server synchronization or transactional player storage.

api_evidence.command_callback: crates/horizon-mod-sdk/wit/horizon.wit: game.get-command-player() returns the authenticated UUID/name only during mod command dispatch; legacy components that do not import it continue to instantiate.
api_evidence.chat_callback: crates/horizon-mod-sdk/wit/horizon.wit: chat.show is documented as local-player-only.
api_evidence.storage: The storage interface exposes mod-scoped string/byte keys and no player key or namespace.
api_evidence.server_events: Player join/leave provide a subject name, but they do not identify the caller of a later command.
api_evidence.claims: The server API exposes rules, block changes, events and drops, but no chunk claim ownership/protection contract.

minimum_host_contract_for_full_port: Provide online-player lookup by name/UUID for invitation target completion.
Provide targeted and party-broadcast chat delivery on the authoritative server.
Provide transactional per-player storage or a synchronized team data service for multiple servers.
Expose claim ownership, protected-action checks and ally access to those checks.

validation.api_runtime_test: cargo test -p horizon-mods --features runtime,pack --test sandbox: 39 passed, 1 ignored; command_player_identity_is_scoped_to_authenticated_dispatch verifies UUID/name delivery and context clearing.
validation.gameplay: harness/gameplay-validation.json; local party create/list/members/info/invite/self-accept rejection/leave passed in-frame and server-thread. Positive invite acceptance with a second authenticated player remains unvalidated.
